recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片滿是含粗大顆粒的嗜酸系細胞，可見雙葉核成熟嗜酸性球、嗜酸性骨髓球，中央還有一顆破裂細胞的顆粒散在背景；嗜酸系在各成熟階段都增加，是嗜酸性球增多的骨髓表現。
features: Numerous eosinophil-lineage cells from myelocyte to mature bilobed forms
Coarse cytoplasmic granules, with some immature purple-staining granules
Disrupted eosinophil with granules dispersed into the background
Admixed neutrophilic band, plasmacytoid lymphoid cells and erythroid precursors
No obvious blast excess in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous eosinophil lineage cells at all stages of maturation, including eosinophilic myelocytes and mature bilobed eosinophils with coarse granules. A ruptured eosinophil releases free granules into the background. Neutrophilic bands, occasional lymphoid cells and erythroid precursors are present, and blasts are not conspicuously increased. Findings show eosinophilic hyperplasia with orderly maturation, compatible with hypereosinophilic syndrome after exclusion of secondary and clonal causes.

ddx.vs: Parasitic infection, drug reaction, allergy and lymphocyte-variant HES produce identical marrow morphology and are excluded clinically and by T-cell phenotyping/clonality.
Requires molecular testing for the fusion; morphologic clues include increased atypical spindled mast cells and elevated serum tryptase.
Requires clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormality or increased blasts with dysplastic eosinophils.
